meta_title: S P R Plumbing & Heating | Plumber Sunderland
meta_description: S P R Plumbing & Heating in Sunderland. Emergency repairs, boiler installations, and heating maintenance. Call now for same-day service.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or boiler breakdown? We're with you in under an hour, day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Sunderland
services_subhead: From burst pipes to full central heating installations, we handle every job with speed and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Burst Pipe Repair
services.desc: Water flooding your home? We attend within the hour, locate the leak, and repair or replace the damaged section. Most jobs finished same day.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Repair
services.desc: New condensing boiler fitted with a 10-year guarantee, or expert repair of your existing system. We diagnose faults quickly and carry most parts on the van.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Complete system design and installation for new builds or replacements. We ensure even heat distribution, reduce your bills, and provide full commissioning.

services.title: Radiator & Pipework Service
services.desc: Radiator replacements, powerflushing to remove sludge, and new pipework installation. We work around your schedule and leave your home clean.

services.title: Gas Cooker & Hob Installation
services.desc: Safe installation of your new gas cooker or hob with full safety checks and certification. We connect, test, and hand over with confidence.

services.title: Landlord Safety Certificates
services.desc: Annual gas safety checks and CP12 certificates for rental properties. Fully compliant inspections, issued same day where possible.

about_pullquote: We turn up on time, fix it right, and never overcharge a neighbour.
about_para_1: S P R Plumbing & Heating has been serving Sunderland and the surrounding area for over 15 years. We started because we were frustrated by unreliable plumbers and cowboys charging sky-high prices for simple jobs. Our founder trained with a master plumber and built the business on the principle of honest work, quick response, and fair pricing.
about_para_2: Today, we're one of Sunderland's most trusted heating and plumbing names. Customers return to us because we answer the phone, show up when we say we will, and leave your home spotless. We hold Gas Safe registration and pride ourselves on never cutting corners — whether it's an emergency at midnight or a planned installation.
reviews_heading: What Sunderland Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Pipe burst on a Saturday morning — absolute nightmare. Phoned S P R and they were here in 40 minutes. Fixed the leak, cleaned up the mess, and even showed me how to turn the stopcock off properly. Fair price too. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had our old boiler replaced last month. The lads were professional, worked tidily, and explained everything as they went. New boiler is warm and quiet. They sorted the paperwork and I've got a 10-year warranty. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Jenny W.

reviews.text: Emergency callout at 11pm on a weeknight — radiator was pouring water. They answered the phone, came out straightaway, and had it sorted by midnight. Professional, friendly, and didn't try to upsell us anything we didn't need. Top marks.
reviews.author: David K.
